model: 3-seed TGN ensemble (random-window trained) + multi-window gradient-boosting stage
split_verified: identical across all 3 TGN members; 0 test packages in any member train/val
threshold_tuned_on: validation only, per decision point; test scored once
why_multi_window: a fixed 3000-event decision point is reached by only 59% of installs; the rest complete first and were judged after the payload had already run, which is detection, not blocking. Scoring at 1500/2200/3000 lets short installs be terminated while still running.

live_validation.malware_local_artifacts: 5/6 blocked, terminated mid-install, venv discarded (package verified absent afterwards)
live_validation.clean_local_artifacts: 4/4 allowed, 0 false positives (1 timed out, no verdict)
live_validation.clean_from_pypi_registry: 4/6 allowed -- requests and certifi FALSELY BLOCKED

KNOWN_LIMITATION: Training benign traces all came from installing LOCAL .tar.gz files. A real 'pip install <name>' downloads from files.pythonhosted.org, and those external connections resemble the exfiltration pattern learned from malware. Result: ~33% false positives on registry installs. Fix requires recollecting benign traces via registry installs.
caveats: 59 malicious samples in test -> roughly +/-4% on F1

part of the statistical contribution comes from volume features tracking package size; this corpus property benefits every tool in OSCAR Table 5a equally but would not transfer to a typosquat of a large real library
live sample sizes (6 malware, 6 clean) are enough to find bugs, not enough to quote a live recall figure

superseded_INVALID.f1_93_22: ensemble members each had a DIFFERENT split; 145/210 test packages sat in sibling training data
superseded_INVALID.f1_92_86: fixed-prefix hybrid; its GBM was fitted on fixed-prefix TGN scores that no longer match the shipped random-window members

train_metrics_note: Train figures are 100% because the gradient-boosting stage is fitted on the training split and memorises it. Validation and test are the meaningful numbers. train->test F1 gap: +7.27% @3000, +13.21% @2200, +11.32% @1500.
